numerical_reference: Full fused RMS/add-RMS/gated-RMS/FP8 projection independently computed from original stored inputs using FP64 equations with prescribed BF16 stores. Large comparisons remain individual operators.

quality_and_execution_scope.independent_quality: Original-input FP64 norm and full projection use canonical atol=rtol=0.03; BF16 residual sum is exact. Large individual-operator references use independent Double Torch math, with prescribed quantizer storage boundaries on CPU.
quality_and_execution_scope.fixed_boundary_encoding: After independent norm quality, the observed stored BF16 boundary is a fixed quantizer input. Independent encoding equations must match exact codes/scales. This stage execution property does not replace original-input full-chain accuracy.
quality_and_execution_scope.special_storage: Independent NaN/+Inf/-Inf and zero masks/signs. Literal original-input gate=-100 witness requires all BF16 negative zeros, FP8 byte0x80, and F32 scale2.2321428288629014e-13. Four CPU negative checks reject class/sign faults.
quality_and_execution_scope.division_rounding: A deterministic midpoint witness requires prescribed F32 quotient rounding before FP8 encoding: rawDouble431.99998831749 becomes432 and unsigned code126.
quality_and_execution_scope.execution_properties: Keep compiled/eager/unfused equality, changed-input replay, packed/offset reads, column scales, input-byte protection and invalid-storage rejection separate from FP64 accuracy.

original_records_kept.reason: Ideal FP64 norm followed by exact code identity rejects legitimate norm rounding at one R05 byte in each layout. Failures and source archive retained.

original_records_kept.superseded_reason: Independent review required special classes/zero signs beyond numeric allclose.
